# claude-code-skills

> Practitioner-built agent skills: FDA 510(k) porting, meeting automation, email, transcripts to Kindle, AI-tell removal, content repurposing.

Install: curl -fsSL https://smorrel1.github.io/claude-code-skills/install.sh | bash
